about: Urban Morph is a full-stack Urban Tech venture studio and service delivery organization working to shape the future of cities. We co-create solutions with public and private partners, incubate innovative technologies, and implement scalable models to solve complex urban challenges. Our work spans mobility, public infrastructure, and citizen engagement, with a strong emphasis on sustainability and real-world impact.

services.title: Innovate
services.intro: OoruLabs within Urban Morph is an urban tech accelerator. We either build our own technologies like Altmo, WattsNext & SyntheSYS, or we work with partners whose solutions can help solve urban problems.

items.title: 🚴 Altmo
items.html: Employee engagement and climate action platform. 10,900+ users from 1,000+ organisations across 135+ cities have logged 2.3 lakh+ sustainable activities and avoided 550+ tonnes of CO₂. Learn more about Altmo

items.title: ⚡ WattsNext Energy
items.html: Energy delivery for electric vehicles and built form: redefining how power reaches vehicles and buildings, from battery intelligence to the last metre of delivery.

items.title: 🎯 SyntheSYS
items.html: AI-native services for orchestrating and coordinating urban solutions and accelerating progress at scale, ward to nation: live platforms such as CFAM, KDEM and Neighbourhoods of the Future, revived civic archives, open tools and data stories. Explore SyntheSYS

services.footer: Write to us if you operate in the urban space and have a problem to be solved.

services.title: Orchestrate
services.intro: For philanthropies, regranters and organizations planning to deploy CSR capital for impact, we provide thesis and strategy to deliver long-term sustainable impact in the urban space.

items.title: 🤝 ITES Partnership
items.html: Strategic partner for India-UK Netzero center, enabling multiple innovators to establish collaborative partnerships. About the ITES partnership

items.title: 🎓 IISc Collaboration
items.html: MoU with Sustainable Transportation Lab, IISc as orchestrators of the Active Mobility Center of Excellence, taking research to the real world.

items.title: 💼 CSR Strategy
items.html: Experience delivering thesis, strategy and orchestration for India's leading CSR organizations with grant budgets up to USD 100 million.

services.footer: Partner with us to drive sustainable urban transformation.

services.title: Execute
services.intro: When it comes to transforming urban spaces, execution matters most. We deliver on-ground projects that create real, measurable change in cities.

items.title: 🚲 Pedaluru
items.html: Bengaluru's public bicycle sharing system, funded by Toyota Mobility Foundation, providing accessible transportation options across the city.

items.title: 🛣️ Church Street First
items.html: Designed and executed India's first pop-up pedestrianization project in collaboration with DULT Bengaluru, transforming urban streets.

items.title: 🚗 Relief Riders
items.html: During COVID-19, mobilised 725 volunteer cyclists for 11,000+ rides across 12 Indian cities, delivering medicines and essentials and safely transporting healthcare and essential service workers.

items.title: 🚶 CFAM
items.html: Council for Active Mobility: India's National Active Mobility Framework, putting streets for people into law, starting with the Karnataka Active Mobility Bill. Visit cfam.in

services.footer: View all projects to see our impact in action.
